snippet.title: Decimate Drive - Trailer
snippet.description:
It's run or die in a killer car infested city. Dash from dumpster to park bench and don’t make a wrong move. Terror trucks, ruthless RVs and other vicious vehicles are always right behind you. Decimate Drive is terrifyingly fast-paced and drenched in atmospheric horror.

Wishlist Decimate Drive on Steam or follow me on Itch.io and get notified when it comes out. It's also a great way to support the game. 😁
